projectDescription: A Tauri desktop application that automates AI video and image generation on Grok by intercepting and mutating browser requests via Chrome DevTools Protocol.
keyFeatures: Automated video generation from images using Grok AI
Image editing with single or multiple reference images
Video extension to seamlessly lengthen existing clips
Real-time NDJSON stream monitoring with live progress updates
CDP-powered browser automation for seamless Grok integration
Local SQLite gallery to store and manage all generated media
Multi-account support with automatic session harvesting
Gallery sync from Grok's media library
publicApiSurface: launchGrokBrowser() — launch Chrome and connect CDP
triggerFire(payload) — arm interceptor and trigger generation
setArmed(armed, prompt, target_uuid) — manually arm/disarm interceptor
syncGalleryFromListApi() — sync gallery from Grok media API
getUvhTree() — retrieve gallery tree for active account
getGenerationHistory() — past generations from local DB
onGenerationProgress(cb) — subscribe to live generation progress events
onStreamComplete(cb) — subscribe to stream completion events
onGrokLoginStatus(cb) — subscribe to account login state changes
onGalleryUpdated(cb) — subscribe to gallery refresh signals
GenerationType: VanillaVideoGen | MultiRefVideoGen | VideoExtension | VanillaImageEdit | MultiRefImageEdit
